Question:
Use the FULL test suite in `test/qa/sanitize_path_parts_loop_value_invariant_suite_test.py` (all 18 test methods in class `TestSanitizePathPartsLoopValueInvariantSuiteQA`). Each test method calls `yt_dlp.utils._utils._sanitize_path_parts(<list_of_strings>)` (defined at line 682 in `yt_dlp/utils/_utils.py`) with a different list-of-strings literal as `parts`. The function body is:
```
682: def _sanitize_path_parts(parts):
683:     sanitized_parts = []
684:     for part in parts:
685:         if not part or part == '.':
686:             continue
687:         elif part == '..':
688:             if sanitized_parts and sanitized_parts[-1] != '..':
689:                 sanitized_parts.pop()
690:             else:
691:                 sanitized_parts.append('..')
692:             continue
693:         # Replace invalid segments with `#`
694:         # - trailing dots and spaces (`asdf...` => `asdf..#`)
695:         # - invalid chars (`<>` => `##`)
696:         sanitized_part = re.sub(r'[/<>:"\|\\?\*]|[\s.]$', '#', part)
697:         sanitized_parts.append(sanitized_part)
699:     return sanitized_parts
```

Consider the LOOP INVARIANT to be checked at the END of every iteration body of the for-loop (line 684) -- specifically, the state of `sanitized_parts` right after one of the three terminating paths of the iteration body completes (`continue` at line 686, `continue` at line 692 after the pop/append at line 689 or 691, or fall-through after the append at line 697). The candidate invariant is:
    INV(sanitized_parts) := all(not p.endswith('.') for p in sanitized_parts)
i.e., NO element of the list `sanitized_parts` ends with the `.` (period) character. Note: an element equal to the literal two-character string `'..'` ends with `.` and therefore VIOLATES this invariant.

Report whether this invariant is held in EVERY iteration across ALL 18 test calls. Iterations are counted per-call and summed across the suite. Return a JSON object with EXACTLY these three keys:
- `total_iterations_observed`: int -- total number of for-loop iterations completed across all 18 test calls (i.e., for each test, the number of iterations executed by the loop on line 684, summed).
- `violating_iteration_count`: int -- number of post-iteration snapshots in which INV(sanitized_parts) is FALSE (i.e., at least one element ends with `.`).
- `is_invariant_always_held`: bool -- True iff `violating_iteration_count == 0`.

Template answer (must match exactly):
{"is_invariant_always_held":"bool","total_iterations_observed":"int","violating_iteration_count":"int"}
